verdict_a.finding: The exact-source native driver requires an initial empty result, a trusted capture click, then waits for a selected visible Article pane before selecting and reading SEO and Schema. The report records both target panes visible/selected, expected no-signal values, and unchanged capture export identity/digest after each selection. This establishes only the named guest subtarget.

verdict_b.finding: Official CI and hosted artifact provenance, verify-scrape, and three valid resource finals support the report. The retained screenshots show setup rather than final SEO/Schema panes, so visual corroboration of final rendering is absent; behavior rests on direct DOM oracle assertions.

adjudication.initial_review: An initial independent reviewer gave FAIL after interpreting zero result tabs in capture_diagnostic.before/immediate as a post-capture contradiction.
adjudication.ruling: REFUTED: before is sampled before the capture click; immediate is sampled immediately after click; the driver then waits for visible Article results and only later selects and observes SEO/Schema. The second fresh reviewer independently confirmed this event order.

limits: No full T08 or full Scrape pass, member/admin, Store-installed, reload, physical resize or release claim. No final-pane screenshot.
